name: modelsell
description: Discover and run ModelSell text, image, video, audio, embedding, and 3D models from Codex through the modelsell CLI.

interface.longDescription: Find ModelSell models available to your API key, inspect their parameters, and generate text, images, video, audio, embeddings, and 3D assets with the modelsell CLI. Async jobs, downloads, and project aliases are handled for you.
defaultPrompt: List the ModelSell image models my key can use
Generate a watercolor beach house image with ModelSell and save it to ./images
Submit a short ModelSell video job and wait for the result
